_comment: Enforced guardrail: blocks any tool call that creates a NEW Snowflake connection (Session.builder / snowflake.connector.connect / Session(...)) so the active Workspace / Streamlit-in-Snowflake session is always reused. To activate, merge this into ~/.snowflake/cortex/hooks.json and set the command to the ABSOLUTE path of block-create-connection.sh in your clone.
